record.edic_text:
1879 epanapauomai {ep-an-ah-pow'-om-ahee}

middle voice from 1909 and 373; TDNT - 1:351,*; v

AV - rest 1, rest in 1; 2

1) to cause to rest upon anything
2) to rest upon anything
3) to settle upon, fix its abode upon
